row.title: REPO-SHAPE-1: split by rate of change and owner; state leaves git
row.body: Evidence: python3 -m foundation reposhape --report on main reads 4,548 tracked files, 482 in the kernel (seed/) and 1,489 in state (queue items, ledgers, packets), a state share of 0.3274 against a budget of 0.25. Decision: every path has a class in doctrine/repo-shape.json; state moves to D1 items, the evidence branches and R2 under Q-SHAPE-state-out-of-git (one area per PR, archived before it leaves main, closing probe reposhape --probe state); the size of a change is gated once, by SMALL-CHANGE-1 (seed/scripts/prsize.py), and an oversize branch is carried by reposhape --split as a stack of in-budget branches sized from the same config, with the original kept. No work is deleted, and the full specification move stays with the DISCLOSE-1 session.

title: REPO-SHAPE-1: split by rate of change and owner; state leaves git
